statement: The ANSYS technology demonstration guide describes the load-step decision as being based on a trial-and-error correction process.
The ANSYS technology showcase example problems guide contains the same passage that the decision is based on a trial-and-error correction process.
[KSP] is the spin softening matrix due to the rotation of the structure in the ANSYS Advanced Analysis Guide.
The EEXTRUDE command documentation shows the topological mapping of 2D elements in the ANSYS Advanced Analysis Guide.
The ANSYS Theory Reference discusses the Topological Method for meshing.
The ANSYS Performance Guide discusses exposing more than 128 logical processors.
The ANSYS Basic Analysis Guide discusses using residual vectors in a modal analysis to improve the accuracy for mode-superposition.
The fedoo stress_equilibrium weakform documents the "log" option as exact logarithmic strain with XBM logarithmic spin.
The fedoo test for axi Simcoon structural checks that the spin tensor has zero entries in the hoop row/column.
The fedoo viewer creates a Qt spin box widget via self.iter_spin = QSpinBox().
The fedoo core problem code builds a NaN mask using np.logical_not(np.isnan(col)).
The okf lattice-beam example note points to the resource ../../Exemples_fedoo/01-simple/lattice_beam.py.
The okf FE2 note describes FE2 micro–macro homogenization with an octet-lattice RVE.
